corpus_defect_notes: Coverage-audit correction: added f22, a task-critical fact the inventory was missing — dynamo charging's space/size drawback (it takes more space than standard batteries because it needs a physical winding handle), which the case's own reference_answer explicitly relies on ('Dynamo and dual charging ... take up too much space') but which f3 alone (dynamo called 'a bit silly') did not cover. Also added f23 and f24, capturing the kinetic-charging component's physical description (watch-battery-sized cell) and the Industrial Designer's candid admission of uncertainty about its lifespan, both relevant to the question's benefits/drawbacks and component-availability framing. Also fixed f7: its text attributed the clause 'especially if marketing internationally' to the Project Manager, but that phrase was actually said by Marketing in a later turn — a genuine speaker misattribution. Narrowed f7's text to only the claim its own source_quote (the Project Manager's basement-flats turn) actually supports, dropping the misattributed clause.
